Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage
  |   |   |-- Reorganize ownership around CanvasWorkspace sessions, MappingDocumentController, MappingEditorCanvas, and page-owned tools; remove injected DiagramService ownership.
  |   |   |-- Preserve authoritative document, selection, history, bridge, and persistence boundaries; distinguish editor rendering from semantic state.
  |   |   `-- Place PromptComposerCoordinator, CanvasViewReceiver, SourceWindowPanel, DiagramSearchService, CanvasTreemapContent, and ProjectionLayoutPanel explicitly before connecting their details.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
  |   |   `-- Distinguish stored composition/layout from presentationScene and resolveDiagramView visible bounds; qualify the obsolete claim that folding never affects displayed sizing. Preserve grid containment and collision rules.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram
  |   |   `-- Update revision identities and separate immutable content/sourceContext from document.diagramPresentations and placement alternatives. The content-oriented organization still fits; reference existing presentation details.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   |-- Add ProjectedPane code-panel content and distinguish derived connection arrows from stored panes.
  |   |   `-- Place SourceWindowPanel as the renderer of eligible source projections outside MappingEditorCanvas, not as their state owner; connect to source-window detail.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Replace DiagramService create/revise calls with stored-revision operations. Preserve versioned controller batches and the distinction between a batch and an exec script.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Add revision-batch reception, alternative/review commands, canvas-view dispatch, and project-diagrams. Distinguish persistence-acknowledged receivers from ordinary apply replies; these fit the existing mutation boundary.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Replace history-as-content-issuer wording with checkpoints over issued revisions; preserve navigation, retained history, and transfer coordination. Include references to checkpointed presentation choices and reviews.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |   |   `-- Replace the obsolete sole-service-writer boundary with explicit revision operations, runtime retention, generateDiagram orchestration, and controller publication. Connect to the existing revision-lifecycle detail in C07 rather than duplicate it.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Diagram search and reveal
  |   |   |-- Attach from MappingPage's DiagramSearchService; develop its existing workspace-navigation responsibility.
  |   |   `-- Show saved/live project documents and the selected proposal, deduplicated current-content indexing, worker cancellation, scope filtering, and revision/hash checks before reveal. Exclude history, source files, and presentation-alternative rows from the indexed content boundary.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Focused canvas projection and layout
  |       |-- Attach from MappingPage.projectDiagrams and ProjectionLayoutPanel; this develops workspace composition rather than a separate content subsystem.
  |       |-- Show explicit or highlighted placement selection, prepareCanvasTransfer copy/remapping, a blank 65-by-35 placeholder, and source-checkpoint/layout provenance.
  |       |-- Show geometry-only layout jobs, cancellation, version-checked commits, membership guards, and Original versus compact placement.
  |       `-- Show saveDocument before child installation, parentCanvasId, preservation of existing sessions, and child-only projection undo/redo; do not imply a live-follow relationship to the source.
  |
  |-- Unified selection - state, gestures and WebSocket  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: CanvasSession
  |       |-- Add prompt-reference synchronization and extension-source capture as SelectionState consumers; distinguish automatic selection bindings from manual reference chips.
  |       `-- Add selectionFocusId's source code-panel preference while preserving independent panel lifetime. These consumers fit the existing state/adapter organization.
  |
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   |-- Reorganize the single generation/install path into edit/create/extend validation, targeted revision imports, pinned references, scoped generation, and variant retention.
  |   |   |-- Separate DiagramGenerator plus generateDiagram from supplied-candidate submission; separate revision application from new-diagram placement against the latest snapshot.
  |   |   `-- Preserve deduplication, cancellation limits, version guards, and acknowledgement retries. Show explicit or matching retained context input, and publish returned conversation context only after installation succeeds.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
  |   |   `-- Add required edit/replace modes, subtree targets, templates, pinned references, panel context identity, variant options, and optional presentation promotion. Keep create/extend-specific fields separate; the request-field organization remains useful.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
  |   |   `-- Add operation, retained candidates, created-node results, runtime session ID, and completed AgentContext output within the existing run lifecycle.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
  |   |   `-- Update task input for operation/templates, references, and replacement scopes; distinguish panel llmSessionId from the actual runtime session ID. Preserve copied-history isolation.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
  |       `-- Add retained review candidates and optional alternatives as outputs distinct from replacing the bound revision; connect from DiagramEditService's variant branch without duplicating review internals.
  |
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Remove the fixed twelve-tool claim and update required edit modes. Keep the interface grouping, but distinguish public tools/routes from browser-internal commands.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Add evidenced create/extend authoring and bridge commands for canvas views, projection, targeted reads/revisions, batches, and checkpoint publication; include context-aware workspace import/export callers.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   `-- Replace RevisionedDiagramService generation wiring with DiagramGenerator orchestration; update complete-history snapshot/publication assumptions to targeted reads and persisted-checkpoint publication.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |       `-- Place GenerationCanvasBridge, CanvasApiProjection, AgentChatService/ChatDiagramTools, and context stores in the existing responsibility groups. Connect to authoring/context details without expanding unrelated backend workflows.
  |
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: PersistentLayer
  |   |   `-- Update publication callers: existing-canvas Save flushes records, checks version, and publishes a checkpoint; initial creation still uses saveMappingProjectDiagram. Preserve autosave versus catalog-publication separation.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
  |       `-- Add focused-projection saveDocument and context-aware MappingWorkspaceService import/export callers to existing storage boundaries. Keep SearchArtifact marked proposed; the supplied search worker does not implement durable source-file indexing.
  |
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
  |   |   `-- Place ChangeTreemapContent alongside the existing review consumer, with version-aware polling and stopping on accepted/archived results; preserve the content-diff review flow.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Change treemaps and destination allocation
  |       |-- Attach from [CALLS]' ChangeTreemapContent component; this develops the canvas's established proposal-review subject.
  |       |-- Show captured text-hunk additions/deletions, inherited DiffTree destinations, equal allocation across resolved destinations, previous-revision inspection, and Unmapped accounting.
  |       `-- Distinguish raw duplicated coverage from allocated LOC; report unresolved targets and zero-area non-text changes. Connect navigation and tint output to ChangeSessionPreview; do not turn heuristic destinations into live anchors.
  |
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Add explicit flush/acknowledgement callers for revision batches, diagram creation/context, and CanvasViewReceiver; they fit the existing owner-to-storage organization.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |       `-- Distinguish full replacement from projection saveDocument, which preserves unrelated sessions; update explicit Save to checkpoint publication and import/export to context-aware server calls.
  |
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) / Projection (C07)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [P1] Presentation alternatives - choose what a placement shows
  |   |   `-- Replace the future-rendering statement with implemented DiagramAlternativeControls and DiagramSidePanelContent. Preserve pinned scopes, independent placement choices, and unchanged bound content.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Presentation projection and editor controls
  |       |-- Attach from [B]'s DiagramPresentation and [P1]'s SidePanel; this develops their established presentation responsibility.
  |       |-- Show canvasDisplayNodes deriving domainNode, presentation, textRows, logical folds, and selected diff state while retaining bound content separately.
  |       `-- Show CanvasRuntimeContext supplying controller/editor/panel models, controls dispatching AlternativeOperation, and side panels rendering regular/diff rows with flow/overlay choices. Keep review application separate.
  |
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Saved CanvasViews and branching
  |       |-- Add MappingPage-owned CanvasViewReceiver, CanvasViewControls command dispatch, and controller-supplied saved views to the existing view lifecycle.
  |       `-- Show display/camera capture before applicable operations, flush before acknowledgement, and separate CanvasViewDiffPreview. Preserve captured branching semantics; caller evidence alone does not establish their replacement.
  |
  |-- Central and side diagrams - Attempt 2  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: 2  PRESENTATION ALTERNATIVES
  |       `-- Add inline-swap and side-panel control entry points, including regular/diff and flow/overlay choices. Connect the existing panels component to C07's shared editor-control detail; preserve the accurate content/review separation.
  |
  |-- Roll-up 1 / g2 / Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) (C12)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Replace stale service/editor ownership with current workspace, editor-adapter, tool, bridge, and persistence boundaries. Place explicit components and link shared details rather than duplicate them.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |   |   `-- Replace obsolete service ownership with operations, retention, generation, and publication; connect to [R] Immutable content and revision lifecycle.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
  |   |   `-- Distinguish stored grid layout from presentation-derived visible bounds; retain the grid organization and collision explanation.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram
  |   |   `-- Update revision identity and separate presentation inputs from immutable content; connect to [R] and [P1] instead of duplicating their detail.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   `-- Add code-panel/source-window rendering and the derived-arrow distinction; connect ProjectedPane to the shared source-window detail.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Replace DiagramService calls with stored-revision operations; preserve versioned mutation boundaries and link the shared agent-access detail.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Include revision batches, review/alternative commands, canvas-view reception, and projection dispatch within the existing edit flow.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |       `-- Replace content-issuance wording with checkpoint publication over issued revisions; retain history and transfer semantics. Preserve accurate [R], [P1], and [P2] branches.
  |
  |-- Roll-up 2 / g2 / Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) (C14)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Reorganize obsolete ownership around current sessions, editor adapter, authoring/source/search tools, saved views, and projection; connect explicit components to shared details.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |   |   `-- Replace the sole-service-writer model with explicit revision lifecycle boundaries; attach [R] Content revisions and publication.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
  |   |   `-- Qualify visible sizing with presentation-derived bounds while preserving stored grid containment and layout rules.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram
  |   |   `-- Update revision identity and annotation ownership; attach [R] and [P] without repeating their accurate content/presentation model.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   `-- Add code-panel and SourceWindowPanel rendering, distinguishing derived arrows; connect ProjectedPane to shared source-window detail.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Replace obsolete content-service callers with stored-revision operations; preserve the existing controller/agent mutation organization.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Add batch, review/alternative, canvas-view, and projection entry points; connect to shared receiver details.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |       `-- Correct history's role to checkpoint publication over issued revisions while preserving navigation and coordinated transfers; retain accurate [R] and [P] content.
  |
  |-- [3] Prompt composition and authoring sessions  new canvas
  |   |-- PromptComposerCoordinator ownership
  |   |   `-- Overview page-owned entries, active composer, drafts, cursors, carried references, panel llmSessionId, and completed AgentContext. This UI lifecycle needs its own overview, separate from backend edit runs.
  |   |-- Selection and pinned reference composition
  |   |   `-- Attach from the coordinator's draft/selectionReferences components; show automatic bindings, manual revision chips, templates, ordered serialization, and carrying a revision into a prompt or onto the canvas.
  |   |-- Submission, retry, and variant review
  |   |   `-- Attach from coordinator submission and VariantReview; show capture-before-submit, exact retained requests, unsettled locking, polling/cancellation, acknowledgement retry, and controller review commands. Reuse existing backend-generation and review-domain details.
  |   `-- Connect from MappingPage's PromptComposerCoordinator; connect submission to DiagramEditService and review updates to MappingDocumentController.
  |
  `-- [3] Canvas source navigation and coverage  new canvas
      |-- SourceWindowPanel ownership and rendering
      |   |-- Overview session-owned ProjectedPane state, selection-derived visibility, focused code-panel preference, and WindowPanel rendering outside MappingEditorCanvas.
      |   `-- Place codeRepo preloading, document-scoped window state, SourceCodePane/SessionCodePanel, and CanvasTreemapContent explicitly. Closing collapses eligible panes rather than deleting selection.
      |-- SourceCodePane navigation and freshness
      |   `-- Attach from SourceCodePane; detail reads, explicit reload, mapped ranges, stale-hash suppression of highlights/compactions, file/history navigation, definitions, and SourcePaneViewState scroll retention.
      |-- Canvas source-coverage treemaps
      |   |-- Attach from CanvasTreemapContent; show actual placements including folded ones, repository/corpus-separated file identities, captured-range validation against source reads, and equal shared-line allocation.
      |   `-- Distinguish mapped-range and referenced-file scopes, stale/unavailable exclusions, refresh, navigation, and non-intercepting tint selection from change-hunk treemaps.
      `-- Connect from MappingPage's SourceWindowPanel and CanvasTreemapContent and [C]'s ProjectedPane. Source reading, navigation, and coverage form a distinct subject requiring an overview, not an expansion of persistence or immutable-content ownership.
